description:
Stop a job that is still queued or running: a duplicate, or a file no longer wanted. It stops within
        seconds and frees its place in the queue. Nothing is charged for a job until its link is taken, so a
        cancelled job costs nothing. A finished job cannot be cancelled ("not_cancellable").

job_id.description: A queued or running job (from download, start_download or get_account)
job_id.title: Job Id

name: cancel_job
title: Cancel a job
